cs.t: Unless they absolutely need it on the go, I’d recommend a proper desktop PC with monitor and good keyboard and mouse (for ergonomic reasons). Personally, if money isn’t tight I’d go for a fanless design like (if you’re in Europe)  https://www.cirrus7.com/en/ . It’s compact and maintenance-free. I agree with the sibling comment that depending on their needs an iPad could be more appropriate (possibly with magic keyboard). I switched my parents from PC to iPad a couple of years ago.
